Areas of Expertise  /  Artificial Intelligence

Straight answers about AI.

What this looks like

We are not here to sell you an AI strategy. Often the honest answer is "not yet, and here is why."

  • Where AI tools save your team real time — and where they quietly create rework
  • Privacy first: what data must never be pasted into a public tool, and why
  • Short, readable internal AI policies for staff, volunteers, and contractors
  • Hands-on training on the tools you already pay for, before buying new ones
  • Evaluating an AI vendor claim, including the questions their sales team hopes you skip

What you walk away with

A shortlist, not a shopping spree

One or two places where this actually helps your work, tried before committing.

Guardrails in plain language

A one-page policy your whole team can follow without a legal review.

Confidence either way

Including the confidence to say no when a tool is not ready for your data.

Curious whether AI is worth it for you?

Sliding-scale rates, nonprofit discounts, and a quote before any work starts. The engagement models are on How We Work.
